task: Package-responsibility survey. For each of these six packages under cli-go/internal, write a one-paragraph summary of its responsibility and its security or correctness properties, using only what the source and doc comments state: statepath, pathsafe, setuptoken, userstore, winsec, paritytest. For each package give at least two specific checkable facts (constants, rejected inputs, resolution order, platform behaviour). Where a package's README or doc comment disagrees with its code, say so. Cite the file for each fact and do not state anything you did not read. This is a read-only task: do not edit, write, or create any file.

criteria.name: per-package-accuracy
criteria.anchor: 1.0: all six packages summarised with correct checkable facts. 0.75: five packages correct. 0.5: three or four correct. 0.25: one or two. 0.0: none, or dominated by wrong facts.

criteria.name: cites-files
criteria.anchor: 1.0: every package has at least one real file citation. 0.5: about half. 0.0: none.

expected_outcomes: statepath: single canonical resolver of the state directory; resolution is YAKOS_DISPATCH_LOG (used verbatim as the directory), then $HOME/.yakos-state, then os.TempDir()/.yakos-state when the home directory cannot be found; DispatchLog() appends dispatch-log.ndjson; also holds SecureDir/SecureFile helpers (secure.go). Note the doc says the override may be 'full path OR directory' but the code treats any value as a directory

pathsafe: dependency-free validator; ValidateProjectSlug accepts the empty string and rejects '.', absolute paths, any '/' or '\', and any value containing '..'; it is an input-shape denylist, not a containment check on the resolved path

setuptoken: one-time first-admin setup token; 32 random bytes base64url; TokenTTL is 30 minutes; ValidateAndConsume is single-use under a mutex and deletes the 0600 marker file; constant-time compare via dashauth.TokenEqual; reload rejects symlinks and group/world-writable files on Unix

userstore: file-backed users.json (0600, parent 0700) with argon2id PHC hashes; LockoutThreshold is 10 failed logins with a 15-minute LockoutCooldown; Verify does the full argon2id derivation even for unknown usernames; Open refuses a symlink or group/other-writable users.json on Unix
winsec: SecureFile is a no-op on non-Windows (POSIX 0600 is the control); on Windows it restricts the file DACL to the current user SID via SetNamedSecurityInfo

paritytest: harness that runs bash yakos and Go yakos with identical args/env and compares stdout/stderr/exit code (CompareExact/JSONL/Regex/Golden/Ignore); binary paths come from YAKOS_BASH_BINARY / YAKOS_GO_BINARY or default via runtime.Caller relative to the repo root; flags the contradiction that paritytest/README.md still states a hardcoded absolute default path to a developer checkout's cli/yakos binary while paritytest.go says defaults are never hardcoded (verify both at eval time)
Every fact is sourced from a file the response actually cites; no invented functions, constants or behaviours
